integrity: No independent audit or independent validation. The supplied analytic proof establishes the universal theorem; finite sampled checks are corroboration only. Literature comparison was limited by unavailable full text of a related but technically different two-level Toeplitz article.
limitations: Exact one-dimensional mean-zero periodic Fourier symbols, arbitrary periods/horizons, normalized compact top-hat kernel, ideal inverse Poisson plus mass, exact arithmetic. The theorem does not transfer its optimal coefficient to volume-constrained Dirichlet finite-element matrices or approximate multigrid implementations. Numerical location decimals are non-certified approximations.
title: Unique minimax mass correction for a periodic top-hat nonlocal diffusion symbol
